subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for both embedded-runner import coupling and Discord monitor decomposition, or should maintainers split the remaining Discord work into a narrower issue after the RuntimePlan RFC owns the runner half?
rationale: Current main partially moved runner policy toward RuntimePlan, but the remaining work spans two owner boundaries and the open RFC only covers one of them.

options.title: Keep as staged umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to track the cross-boundary cleanup until both the RuntimePlan runner work and Discord monitor split have narrower landing paths.

options.title: Split Discord follow-up
options.body: Move the Discord monitor half into a dedicated issue and let the open RuntimePlan RFC own only the embedded-runner cleanup.

options.title: Close after RFC adoption
options.body: Close this issue once maintainers decide the RuntimePlan RFC supersedes the runner half and no longer want a Discord architecture cleanup tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep as staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to track the cross-boundary cleanup until both the RuntimePlan runner work and Discord monitor split have narrower landing paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior keep-open review and is the clearest visible reviewer tied to both affected surfaces in the issue context.
